en-US.longDescription: MobileTogether Designer is a free-to-use mobile development environment for creating sophisticated mobile apps using a powerful visual and functional programming paradigm that requires no mobile development experience. To build a custom, no-code database app, use RecordsManager inside MobileTogether Designer.
en-US.name: Altova MobileTogether Designer 10.0

zh-CN.longDescription: MobileTogether Designer 是一个免费的移动开发环境，无需移动开发经验也可以通过强大的可视化和功能性编程范例创建高级移动应用。要创建自定义的无代码数据库应用，请在 MobileTogether Designer 中使用 RecordsManager。
